Neutral calm expression.
- scp-010-collar: A heavy cast iron collar: a plain dark grey-black metal ring (color RGB 45,45,45) about the thickness of a wrist, hinged so it can lock around a human neck, with a small blank numbered metal tag hanging from it (the tag bears no legible characters). Faint intricate seams hint at electronics inside. Default look (use this only if the Scene below does not specify different clothing/expression for this moment): Closed and latched around the wearer's neck.

A small embossed emblem of tiny figures building a pyramid is stamped into the casing, with no legible text. Default look (use this only if the Scene below does not specify different clothing/expression for this moment): Held in both hands, its little screen glowing faintly.

Attending Researcher (Male) stands at a central table where one box lies open, lifting the SCP-010 collar out with both hands; the SCP-010 remote rests in the foam padding beside it.
